data.gender_notes: Jharvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jharvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jhar' meaning 'to flow' and 'Vika' meaning 'prosperity'. This name is associated with the Goddess of prosperity and abundance. It is believed that the name Jharvika bestows wealth, prosperity, and good fortune upon the bearer. The name Jharvika carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jharvika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jharvika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jharvika total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
